command.name: execute-plan
options: [--attestation-custodian <file-pkcs8> --attestation-principal-id <uuid> --attestation-key-file <path> --attestation-passphrase-file <path> (repeat one through 64 aligned credential triplets under the selected custody)]
command.summary: Execute an ordered AI-agent ledger plan inside a single atomic book transaction. Attestation credentials are required exactly when the request contains a mutating step and forbidden for a query-only or assertion-only plan. Summary output is the default; request the full execution journal explicitly when needed.
